definitions.full: H5980. ummah I. [ עֻמָּה ] noun feminine juxtaposition, but only in stative construct with force a preposition close by, side by side with, parallel to, agreeing with, corresponding to ; — stative with עֻמַּת , except Eccl 5:15 always with לְ , suffix לְעֻמָּתוֺ , once plural construct לְעֻמּוֺת Ezek 45:7 ; — a. close by, side by side with: Exod 25:27 ( 37:14 ), 28:27 ( 39:20 ), Lev 3:9 יְסִירֶנָּה הֻעָצֶה לְעֻמַּת shall take it away close by the backbone; especially of what is parallel , Ezek 42:7 the wall alongside of the chambers; of the contiguous portions in Ezekiel's division of the land, alongside of each other, 45:6-7 , 48:13 , 18 (twice in verse); 48:21 ; of movement in parallel lines, 2Sam 16:13 Shimei was going along לְעֻמָּתוֺ parallel with him, 16:13 ; Ezek 1:20 לְעֻמָּתָם יִנָָּֽשְׂאוּ וְהָאוֺפַנִּים , 1:21 ; 3:13 ; 10:19 ; 11:22 ; 3:8 מְּנֵיהֶם לְעֻמַּת חֲזָקִים פָנֶיךָ נָתַתִּי by the side of their face (which, as antagonism is implied, = against , RV), 3:8 . b. agreeing with, corresponding to (a common result of juxtaposition), Exod 38:18 a screen five cubits high החצר קלעי לעמת agreeing with (RV answerable unto ) the hangings of the court (in height), Ezek 40:18 ; probably also 1Chr 26:16 ; Neh 12:24 ל ׳מִשְׁמָר מִשְׁמָר ward corresponding to ward. c. correspondingly to , 1Chr 24:31 they also cast lots אֲחֵיהֶם לְעֻמַּת correspondingly to their brethren, v b the head, correspondinly to his younger brother, 26:12 to these . . . belonged charges correspondingly to (in common with) their brethren. ** Eccl 7:14 side by side with, as well as . d. before a sentence (Ges § 155n ), 1Chr 25:8 (strangely) כַּגָּדוֺל כַּקָּטֹן לְעֻמַּת (see Ke) correspondingly to (the principle) of as the small so the great; Eccl 5:15 שֶׁכָּא כָּלעֻֿמַּת quite exactly as he came, so shall he go (but Lambert RŠJ xxxi. 47 , Rahlfs Th. Lt. -z. 1896, 587 כִּלְעֻמַּת ). e. מִלְּעֻמַּת (see מִן 1c, 9 a ) 1Kin 7:20 close beside .
